description: Add LRU eviction (bounded capacity) plus per-entry TTL expiry to an unbounded cache
prompts: Cache.java's Cache is an unbounded HashMap wrapper - get/put never evict anything. Turn it into an LRU cache with a TTL: the constructor takes (int capacity, long ttl) - a max size and a time-to-live in seconds. put(String key, int value, long now) stores a value timestamped at `now`. get(String key, long now) returns the value if present AND not expired (now - storedAt < ttl), else null - and an expired entry must be REMOVED the moment it's observed to be stale. Both get and put must refresh a key's recency. When put() would exceed `capacity`, evict the LEAST recently used entry (recency = most recent get OR put) before inserting the new one.
name: add_java_lru_cache_with_ttl
